blind-hunter: A peer receipt can survive conflicting acquisition and suppress an unreadable orphan claim when this owner has no receipt. The built-assembly probe reproduces verified emptiness; use the queried owner’s verified receipt rather than peer receipts.
The marker opener rejects only its final link. A linked diagnostics/run parent still redirects the marker read and can release failure retention; verify the owned parent chain.

The helper returns false for absence, read failure and cancellation, and provisioning gates consume that answer as verified absence. Keep conservative retention but refuse startup on unverifiable markers and preserve cancellation handling.

Each unreadable claim scans all peer receipts, adding C×P synchronous reads. Removing the unsound peer-receipt exemption removes this introduced traversal; existing receipt-bound ownership remains the exclusion proof.

The probe bypasses owner initialization and supplies an invalid runner-held descriptor directly to an internal method. Production non-null snapshots come only from reader-valid descriptors; every real provisioned owner is initialized before observation. Refusing to replace a malformed immutable snapshot is the intended fail-closed behavior, not a supported repair path.

A malformed durable binding snapshot can retain matching run IDs but omit or mistype deadlines. An observed duration then dereferences that shape before final schema validation and can escape exact cleanup as NullReferenceException; refuse it as InvalidDataException.

The process stopping timestamp precedes shutdown, while the five-second immediate recording allowance starts after shutdown. Subtracting the former can erase an otherwise available metadata recovery allowance; record and use the actual metadata start without changing the stopping deadline.

A stalled device can block synchronous flush, as it can other filesystem operations. This requires a storage failure outside everyday local-run behavior; hard isolation/cancellable device I/O would require extra machinery rather than a direct correction. The change continues to await a confirmed flush before publication.

A Unix power loss can lose a rename without a containing-directory sync. The filed consequence is limited to host power failure, and correcting it requires new platform-specific directory-handle publication semantics beyond the direct file-flush correction. No host-power-failure qualification is claimed.
edge-case-hunter: Independently reproduced the same orphan-claim/stale-peer-receipt false emptiness as B1; keep this finding separate before grouping.

An existing unreadable or exclusively held cleanup marker is treated as absent by startup gates. This is the same role-conflation defect as B3; retention and provisioning need different conservative decisions.
